purpose: Exploratory follow-up isolating focal class-weight convention after tracing author initialization; declared before these two runs
interpretation: One-variable class-weight comparisons against focal50 in the original screen. Same data, seed, architecture, batch, learning rate and 4000 updates. Post-initial-screen exploratory follow-up, not an independent confirmation.
author_weight_derivation: Initializer maps w=236 to w/(1+w); focal alpha=1-w/(1+w)=1/237, giving positive/negative ratio 1/236. Our odds-weight loss divides their loss by 236/237. This is a checked-in source convention, not proof of every published run configuration.
